heroHeadline: Day 678: Gerardo Mérida's First SDNY District Court Hearing Before Judge Polk Failla — Former Sinaloa Security Secretary Faces Life Sentence; Prosecution Phase of Rocha Moya Indictment Wave Begins
heroSubtitle: 678 days of cartel civil war — June 1, 2026: Former Sinaloa Secretary of Public Security Gerardo Mérida Sánchez appeared at noon before Federal District Judge Katherine Polk Failla in the Southern District of New York — his first substantive district court hearing since surrendering in Arizona on May 11. Mérida faces life imprisonment for allegedly accepting $100,000/month from Los Chapitos to tip off cartel leadership about planned SEDENA and SEMAR raids; he is represented by former AUSA Sarah Rebecca Krissoff (financial fraud/money laundering specialist). Of the 10 SDNY-indicted Sinaloa officials: 3 in Brooklyn MDC (Mérida, Díaz Vega, Inzunza Cazárez); on-leave Governor Rocha Moya and others appeared before Mexico's FGR as witnesses (May 26); 3 fugitives (Contreras Núñez, Dionisio Hipólito, Valenzuela Millán) remain non-compliant past their deadlines. El Chinacate (Isaí Martínez Zepeda) at Altiplano (~27 days remaining on 60-day extradition clock). Upcoming US court calendar: El Mayo EDNY July 20, Ovidio NDIL July 27, Joaquín NDIL Aug 31. CJNG-Chapitos alliance fully collapsed: El Mencho killed (Feb 2026), El Jardinero arrested (Apr 29), BC territorial rupture confirmed (May 28–30) — CJNG now in open conflict with Chapitos over Tijuana, Mexicali, Ensenada. La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops under interim Governor Bonilla Valverde. Running toll: ~2,425+ homicides (Noroeste) / 3,000+ (WSJ) since September 9, 2024; ~5,800 disappearances (NGO Sabuesos Unidas AC).
